summary: Kandal M Venture Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that shareholders at an Extraordinary General Meeting held September 22, 2026 approved a 40-for-1 share consolidation, with 68,279,730 votes (about 90.68% of shares outstanding on the August 27, 2026 record date) present in person or by proxy; 99.59% voted in favor, 0.40% against. The consolidation, effective on a board-set date no later than October 13, 2026, combines forty class A and class B ordinary shares, par US$0.00001, into one share of par US$0.0004, reducing authorized capital to 125,000,000 shares. No special-situation transaction is involved; no deal terms, advisor or board recommendation on a transaction were disclosed.
